title: Japanese connection and comprehension verb public development contrasts

provenance.sentence_provenance: All six Japanese sentences were written for this draft. No dictionary examples, corpora, or external sentence text were copied.
provenance.reference_provenance: First-party Taiwan Traditional Chinese references for the original examples, with independent language review.

purpose: Contrast route, telephone connection and comprehension for 通じる and guard the distinct transitive 通す construction.

review_and_adoption.process: Independent language review and adoption must be recorded in a separate data-only PR before any rule uses these rows for acceptance.
review_and_adoption.scope_limit: The six original rows cover these specific senses and one related-verb control. They do not score the fixed sample or define every sense.

items.jp: この小道は駅まで通じている。
semantic_checks: 小道 is the route, and 駅まで marks its endpoint.
通じている describes the route reaching the stated destination.
semantic_unknowns: The source does not state who uses the path or how long it is.

control.source_cue: 小道 is a physical route, and 駅まで gives its endpoint.
stable: The Japanese and Taiwan Traditional Chinese sentences are original first-party development material.
changed: This row samples the route sense of 通じる.
limits: This row does not define every route use of 通じる.

items.zh_hant: 打給店裡的電話接通了。
semantic_checks: 電話が通じた states that the telephone connection reached the store.
The source does not name a caller.
semantic_unknowns: The source does not state whether anyone spoke or what was said.

control.source_cue: 電話 and 店 identify a telephone connection to a destination.
stable: The Japanese and Taiwan Traditional Chinese sentences are original first-party development material.
changed: This row samples successful telephone connection for 通じる.
limits: The source does not state the caller or call purpose.

items.jp: この辺りでは携帯電話がつうじない。
semantic_checks: 携帯電話 is the telephone whose connection fails in this area.
つうじない is a finite negative form of the same verb, written in kana.
semantic_unknowns: The source does not state why the connection fails or how large the area is.

control.source_cue: 携帯電話 identifies a phone connection, while つうじない gives its negative state.
stable: The Japanese and Taiwan Traditional Chinese sentences are original first-party development material.
changed: This row samples a finite kana spelling and failed telephone connection.
limits: The source does not identify a network or technical cause.

items.jp: この説明は子どもにも通じた。
items.zh_hant: 連小孩也理解了這個說明。
semantic_checks: この説明 is the content understood.
にも marks children as included among those who understood it.
semantic_unknowns: The source does not say how the explanation was given.

control.source_cue: 説明 is understood by children, as marked by にも.
stable: The Japanese and Taiwan Traditional Chinese sentences are original first-party development material.
changed: This row samples comprehension for 通じる.
limits: The source does not state whether every child understood the explanation.

items.jp: 短い冗談は彼には通じなかった。
items.zh_hant: 他沒有理解這個簡短的笑話。
semantic_checks: 短い冗談 is the content that does not get through to him.
通じなかった marks the failed comprehension.
semantic_unknowns: The source does not explain why he did not understand the joke.

control.source_cue: 彼には identifies the person who does not understand the joke.
stable: The Japanese and Taiwan Traditional Chinese sentences are original first-party development material.
changed: This row samples failed comprehension for 通じる.
limits: The source does not state the reason or audience beyond 彼.

items.jp: 駅員は乗客を改札口から通した。
items.zh_hant: 站務員讓乘客通過驗票閘門。
semantic_checks: 駅員 is the agent, and 乗客を is the person allowed through.
改札口から marks the gate as the passage route.
通した is transitive 通す, not the intransitive lemma 通じる.
semantic_unknowns: The source does not state why the passenger is being let through.

control.source_cue: The agent, direct object and passage route mark transitive 通す.
stable: The Japanese and Taiwan Traditional Chinese sentences are original first-party development material.
changed: This row is a distinct-lemma control, not a 通じる sense.
limits: Do not use this row to select a lexical gloss for 通じる.

level_note: Approximate sentence difficulty only. These examples do not establish JLPT coverage.
